actual_objective_from_source.target: Exact terminal bid/ask midpoint change sign at decision+h wall-clock minutes; corrected decimal target identity retained.
actual_objective_from_source.outputs: 60 independent logit_up outputs; no learned market-stillness probability.
actual_objective_from_source.loss: Unweighted binary cross entropy on observed, nonzero signs with terminal strictly before own cutoff.
actual_objective_from_source.magnitude: Any positive or negative terminal change has equal cell weight irrespective of movement size.
actual_objective_from_source.path: Terminal direction does not identify a quiet path; a large round trip can finish at its starting price.
actual_objective_from_source.unknown: Missing outcomes and ties are distinct; missing is not STILLE.

goal_alignment: No STILLE target/output/loss exists in the fitted binary experiment.
No declared size semantics separate negligible price changes from meaningful moves.
The1..60minute experiment does not measure the requested minute/hour/swing domain.
A first-event-only target loses subsequent opposite movements. Five input timeframes are not proof of ordered movement targets and evaluation on all five requested scales.
These are objective gaps, not proof of the cause of near-chance ranking on the narrower binary task.

saved_analysis.population: 47602 TRAIN parents May-Dec2024;17288 later reused-development Q1_2025 parents; targets decoded only through parent64889.
saved_analysis.independent_review: Read-only peer found no concrete arithmetic/mask defect; weighted accuracy exact, loss/Brier reconciliation max2.3e-16. No separate raw-data/model replay.

largest_absolute_move_group.definition: At or above shared TRAIN75th percentile of absolute observed nonzero mature five-minute return; outcome-defined diagnostic only.

interpretation: Forecast probabilities are narrow around0.5; this is uncertainty in the binary task, not a forecast of a quiet market.
Higher reported confidence does not show a strong descriptive ability to rank correct versus incorrect predictions.
Weak ranking also appears among larger realized moves; it is not confined to the smallest return group.
For the three stored M5 tags, only4 or5 of17192 eligible later rows are UNKNOWN; this limited missingness cannot account for the entire poor ranking.
No inference is made about unrecorded full per-row indicator coverage, statistical significance, or future trading selection.

indicator_consumption.interpretation: Profile parking, genuinely missing observations, input/gradient contact, and useful learned prediction are four different facts; causal indicator value remains unqualified.

recommended_target_direction_not_impleme.forecast_object: Probabilistic ordered meaningful upward/downward movements and still intervals, with explicit size/time/observation semantics evaluated on M5/M15/H1/H4/D1. Output representation and loss are not yet selected.
recommended_target_direction_not_impleme.quiet_versus_uncertain: Quiet is a small observed movement/path; uncertain is a broad forecast. Probability_up0.5 does not define quiet. Neither is a trade FLAT decision.
recommended_target_direction_not_impleme.path_requirement: Count the rise and the return fall in order, including falls from a later peak back to the origin without crossing below that origin. Terminal evidence is separate; first-event-only classification is insufficient.
recommended_target_direction_not_impleme.time_requirement: Every forecast needs a time/event reference to be falsifiable. Multiple horizons or movement-event time can provide this without imposing a holding rule.
unresolved_numeric_contract: Definition/unit/source of meaningful movement and quiet range; no invented numerical cutoff.
Which exact minute/hour/session-day queries or movement-event definition are supported by existing targets.
Loss weighting and class balance must follow that target identity, not an opportunistic best-horizon search.
recommended_target_direction_not_impleme.reuse: Existing M1 outcomes support1..480minutes with separate terminal/path masks; existing session-based targets support1/5/20trading days. These are reusable sources with different semantics, not qualified ordered-movement targets on all five timeframes.
recommended_target_direction_not_impleme.not_a_promised_fix: Adding a quiet class or longer horizons alone is not evidence of improved direction or edge.

limits: No causal root cause of weak binary ranking established.
No revised target generation, normalization fit, model construction, forward/backward, training, evaluation launch or restart.
No economic inference, TEST access, trades or feature activation/filtering.
The two earlier source variants remain implemented but not genuinely qualified or measured for improvement.

recommended_forecast_contract_proposal.semantic_preference: Operator answered: both directions in an out-and-back sequence count on all five timeframes. This supersedes the earlier first-event-only recommendation; no endpoint-versus-first-event preference remains pending.
recommended_forecast_contract_proposal.forecast_role: Only a market forecast from information observable atD. Entry, sizing, Exit, orders and economic utility are later roles.
recommended_forecast_contract_proposal.origin: Existing completed-M5 observation clock and existing causal multi-timeframe/family inputs. Naming a stored field entry does not grant trade authority.

query.movement_size_a: Explicit positive size in source-defined bps or an explicitly bound causal-scale unit. It is a forecast query, not a stop or take-profit. No default10bps or fitted later-data threshold is adopted.
query.time_reference_h: Explicit clock kind and supported horizon/session query. A finite measurement domain is necessary; no hard60minute product limit is adopted.
query.supported_domain: Must be declared and verified before any genuine target or fit; current owners do not accept arbitrary hours/days or arbitrary source clocks automatically.
query.timeframe_scale: M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 are all required forecast-assessment scales. A timeframe is not automatically a single future-bar horizon, a source sampling resolution or a separate model.

recommended_forecast_contract_proposal.candidate_price_reference: Source-verified nominal M1 opening bid/ask midpoint convention can preserve the current decimal target basis. It is not a proof of synchronized subminute executable quotes; midpoint intrabar extrema cannot be invented from separately timed bid/ask highs/lows.

terminal_companion.quantity: Distribution of signed endpoint return R_h, not just its conditional mean.
terminal_companion.interpretation: P(R_h>a),P(R_h<-a),P(abs(R_h)<=a) describe terminal movement only. A broad symmetric distribution has mean0 but is not quiet.
terminal_companion.no_joint_path_claim: Marginal endpoint distributions alone do not identify a first crossing, joint reversal trajectory or executable trade.
terminal_companion.implementation_scope: A separate proposed forecasting quantity, not authority to add another head or loss now.

partial_observation_requirement.existing_support: Reuse allowed_outcomes and exact reason codes from the first-quote owner where its price/time semantics match.
partial_observation_requirement.rejected_shortcut: Train/evaluate only singleton outcomes and present their accuracy as full-population quality.
partial_observation_requirement.unproven_shortcut: A negative-log-sum over allowed classes is not assumed to yield identifiable calibrated class probabilities without a justified observation/coarsening model.
partial_observation_requirement.minimum_honest_route: Either define an observable sampled-grid target with appropriate limited claim, or establish the partial-observation likelihood/identification and coverage before fitting.
partial_observation_requirement.evaluation: Show identifiable labels, partial-label sets and wholly unknown outcomes separately. Evaluate no-event and directional components with appropriate references and bounds; no favorable subset selection.

minimum_owner_changes_if_later_authorize: Reuse causal quote/axis/clock and observation-mask owners. First-positive-quote can be a component only; ordered subsequent legs and their observation semantics require an explicit successor contract.
Reuse current native representation and existing shared-query-decoder pattern; no new encoder or parallel feature framework is needed to define the forecast role.
Bind exact query domain, source identity, class/mask semantics, loss and forecast output identity together. Do not edit only HORIZONS_MINUTES or rename old targets.
Keep the original binary function/checkpoints for scoped comparisons; any changed function needs its own qualification, which remains prohibited.
Preserve eight families and D1/macro. Parked features and missing observations remain documented; no automatic feature activation or deletion is implied.
evaluation_success_criteria: Evaluate occurrence, direction, order, size and timing on each declared timeframe against suitable predeclared TRAIN-only references. Scoring rules and label observability must match the selected output contract.
Per-class coverage/quality, proper probability scoring where labels are identified, and explicit uncertainty where they are not.
Show every declared timeframe/time/size scale, observed and unknown outcomes, and overlapping-event dependence; no best-horizon or best-threshold choice from later results.
Keep TRAIN fit, later generalization and eventual trading value separate. Improved no-event accuracy alone does not establish directional edge.
unresolved_before_implementation: Exact source-verifiable price/path reference and resolution, including synchronization and intrabar ordering limits.
Reproducible movement/reversal extraction and event boundaries preserving both legs without future-dependent forecast origins.
Supported time/size query domain and scale semantics for each of M5/M15/H1/H4/D1, with source/recipe-derived numeric values.
Ordered probabilistic output, matching loss/scoring and justified partial-observation treatment; actual coverage for the chosen successor target.
recommended_forecast_contract_proposal.no_causal_edge_claim: This repairs objective semantics. It is not a demonstrated cause or cure of the old binary-ranking weakness.

ordered_movement_requirement.scope: Semantic requirement, not an implemented target extractor, model architecture, loss or execution admission.
ordered_movement_requirement.forecast_quantity: The ordered meaningful movements and still intervals after the declared forecast origin, including direction, size and timing on each required timeframe.
ordered_movement_requirement.round_trip: For an observed path P0 -> P1 above P0 -> P0, preserve UP then DOWN. The DOWN leg is relative to P1, even though the path never goes below P0. Likewise preserve DOWN then UP and further movements; no fixed two-leg cap.
ordered_movement_requirement.first_event_limit: The existing first-positive-quote owner may supply reusable observations and ambiguity logic; its three first-event classes alone cannot represent the return leg.
ordered_movement_requirement.joint_order_requirement: UP and DOWN can both occur in one future window. Two marginal occurrence probabilities are not mutually exclusive and need not sum to one; they also do not identify order. The eventual output must support the ordered-event claim it is scored on.
ordered_movement_requirement.five_timeframe_requirement: Declare targets and evaluation for M5/M15/H1/H4/D1, with the size/time domain and observation resolution for each. Do not assume that five input streams provide five forecast targets or that every timeframe must receive the same label.
ordered_movement_requirement.stillness: No meaningful movement under the declared scale on a sufficiently observed interval. Endpoint cancellation, a missing second leg, unknown intrabar order, or low forecast confidence cannot establish stillness.
ordered_movement_requirement.causality: Future realized turns may be target metadata only. Forecast origins, inputs and query settings cannot depend on those future turns. Score a sequence forecast issued atD separately from forecasts refreshed after part of the sequence becomes observable.
ordered_movement_requirement.dependence: Report each declared timeframe while accounting for overlapping paths and repeated views of the same movement; do not count them as independent confirmations.
ordered_movement_requirement.open_design: Exact source price/grid, movement and reversal extraction, size/time domain by scale, event boundaries and partial-observation handling must be specified before implementation. No threshold, segmentation algorithm or new model is adopted here.
